<a id="cave_data_offsets"></a>
### [`cave_data_offsets`](../../../../src/cave/cave_data.asm#L6) `$5806-$582D`

*data*

20 words: for caves 1-20, the offset of the cave definition from $582e.

<a id="cave_data_a"></a>
### [`cave_data_a`](../../../../src/cave/cave_data.asm#L13) `$582E-$585E`

*data*

Each cave definition: 32 bytes of header, then drawing commands, then $ff. The loader copies 240 bytes to $2400. Header bytes: 0 cave number, 2-3 diamond values, 4-8 seeds, 9-13 diamonds needed, 14-18 times, 19-21 colours, 24-31 random objects and limits. A command byte holds the cell code in bits 0-5 and the command in bits 6-7. Cell $25 sets the start of Rockford.
Cave number 1: cave A.
